latestVersion.changelog:
Português Editor AI — Initial Release

- Launches a cloud-based tool for editing videos with Portuguese subtitles and captions.
- Supports uploading MP4, MOV, AVI, and WebM files up to 500MB.
- Enables quick 1080p MP4 exports, typically delivered within 1–2 minutes.
- Designed for Brazilian and Portuguese content creators working with short video clips.
- Automatic session handling, free token support for trial use, and clear error codes for common issues.
